content: PostgreSQL race-condition prevention: read-committed lost updates fixed by SELECT FOR UPDATE row locks inside a transaction; SKIP LOCKED lets concurrent workers grab distinct rows (job queue pattern); atomic UPDATE with predicate (UPDATE ... WHERE condition) is single-statement safe; unique constraints catch duplicate inserts (email example); pg_advisory_xact_lock for per-user serialization. Idempotency: idempotency key + result stored in same transaction as the work; dedupe table with unique constraint (INSERT fails cleanly on duplicate); transactional outbox for event+state atomicity; replay protection for retries; reaper jobs to expire pending keys. Crash-safety rule: work and dedup-record must commit atomically or retry double-executes. SERIALIZABLE isolation has overhead and conflicts with SKIP LOCKED queue patterns. GS2 game-server pattern: duplicationAvoider key on consume/grant actions, replay success responses on retry.
